title: Login and checkout failures
executive_summary: Errors on login and checkout began at 09:29-09:30Z, about one minute after auth-service 2.14.0 deployed at 09:28Z. Auth-service logs show 'unsupported key type EC in JWKS' under jose-4.2 from 09:29Z onward. Payment-service auth checks then return upstream 500s. Error rates rose roughly 40x on auth-service, 9x on api-gateway and 7x on payment-service. Latency, DB connection and timeout metrics are flat, so this is a functional failure rather than resource saturation. Recommended action: roll back auth-service to 2.13.4 and verify recovery.

hypotheses.description: auth-service 2.14.0 JWT/JWKS validation change (jose-4.2) cannot handle EC keys, causing token validation exceptions and 5xx responses. Mechanism: After deploy at 09:28Z, auth-service validates tokens with jose-4.2, which throws 'unsupported key type EC' for JWKS key kids. Login and token checks return 5xx. payment-service's authorization call to auth-service receives 500 and fails after retries. api-gateway propagates the 5xx to clients, who are logged out.

corrective_actions: Roll back auth-service from 2.14.0 to 2.13.4 now, then confirm error rates return to baseline on auth, gateway and payment.
Re-run any pending payment retries or checkout flows once rollback is verified.
preventive_actions: Add contract tests for JWKS key types (EC, RSA, OKP) to the auth-service CI pipeline before release.
Require canary rollout for auth-service changes that touch token validation.
monitoring_recommendations: Alert on auth-service TokenValidationException count and on 5xx rate above 1% for 2 minutes.
Track payment-service auth retry rate and upstream 500s from auth-service.
limitations: Telemetry was checked only for auth, payment and api-gateway. Postgres, redis and user-service were not checked.

conclusion: The INC-002 login and checkout 5xx spike is most likely caused by auth-service release 2.14.0 (deployed 09:28Z, migrating JWT validation to jose-4.2). From 09:29Z the new build rejects EC keys in the JWKS with 'unsupported key type EC', producing 5xx on auth paths. payment-service authorization calls to auth-service then fail with 500 and are retried, and api-gateway errors rise in step. Strongest candidate: rollback of auth-service to 2.13.4. Not yet confirmed by a rollback or a controlled test.
